extra.reason: Implemented and verified CLI, browser UI, audio engine, arrangement, and sequencer workflows.
Pinned and routed the native and WASM upstream libpaulstretch core; all integration checks passed.
Implemented ffmpeg-backed MP3 CLI input, explicit browser MP3 support, Swiss visual system, and verified builds plus browser smoke.
Applied refined dark-only Swiss UI, removed marketing copy, added stop controls to every panel, and verified layer playback plus stop behavior.

Integrated the UI into Layers and Sequence regions, added editable one-dimensional cells with relative widths, wired relative timing into scheduling, and verified browser editing plus responsive layout.
Implemented solid contiguous sequence playback fills, longer-cell looping, and global ADSR envelope controls; typecheck, tests, build, and browser verification passed.

Deterministic audible-window selection and playback-time repair now relocate silent generated segments before layer, arrangement, or sequence playback; 11 tests, build, and browser verification passed.

Sequence rendering now skips unreferenced layers, serializes Paulstretch WASM work, and retries failed or silent renders with bounded audible fallback parameters; browser reproduction and 12-test build verification passed.

Added per-sequence base duration multiplied by relative cell lengths, unlimited sequence creation and selection, independent sequence editing/deletion, and active-sequence randomization; browser, test, typecheck, and build verification passed.
Removed gap cells, added per-sequence inter-cell gap duration, and added per-sequence loop-through toggle; 14 tests, build, and browser verification passed.
Implemented accessible Layers and Sequence tabs with compact responsive sizing and browser-verified switching.
Minimized hero, aligned control values and inputs inline, standardized action sizing, and verified desktop/mobile layouts.
Rendered all sequences as selectable matrix rows and preserved active sequence editing, cell selection, and resizing.
Removed sequence label cells and visible cell indices, used layer names only, and flattened matrix spacing and padding.
Added sequential Play all playback for every non-empty sequence with cross-row progress tracking.
Replaced concatenated per-sequence buffers with one combined nested sequencer schedule and verified distinct sequence durations play in order.
Play all now mixes every non-empty sequence from the same playback start and tracks each row independently.
Added browser-painted animated construction footer for layer, arrangement, sequence, and Play all render operations; verified with browser smoke and project checks.
Moved the animated black-and-yellow construction stripes onto the footer background and removed the CONSTRUCTION >>> label.
Reduced the footer to a 340px maximum and 16px rendered height, anchored it at viewport bottom with zero bottom padding, and softened the animated stripe colors.
Removed footer stripes and animation in favor of a static black bottom bar; sequence render mixing now applies ADSR independently to each scheduled cell, with regression coverage.
Removed the per-layer Loops field and control, fixed shared and WASM layer rendering to one pass, and retained sequence-level clip gating.
Added configurable Rows × Columns sequence-grid randomization and percentage progress in the processing footer; verified both in browser.
Set default ADSR to the ambient envelope: 1s attack, 0.8s decay, 70% sustain, and 2s release.
Added animation-frame yields between render units so the processing footer percentage visibly advances; browser observed 25%, 50%, and 100%.
